name: FY 2017 PMMR Data Extract
description:
This dataset is an extract from New York City's Fiscal Year 2017 Preliminary Mayor's Management Report (PMMR), which tracks the performance of city agencies against specific goals. Each row represents a single performance indicator for an agency, such as call volumes, website visits, or service outcomes, along with historical actuals and forward-looking targets.

The data includes the reporting agency (45 distinct agencies, including 3-1-1), a PMMR goal code (e.g., 1a, 2a), and a binary flag marking whether the indicator is critical. The performance_indicator column holds nearly 2,000 distinct metric names. Historical results are provided for FY2014, FY2015, and FY2016, and targets are given for FY2017 and FY2018. Two additional columns compare four-month actuals for FY2016 and FY2017, enabling year-over-year progress checks. Values are stored as text and mix numbers, percentages, times, and
